summary: AI teacher-auth signed-cookie parsing now rejects validly signed teacher auth cookies when actorId or sessionId contains unsafe identifier characters. This keeps unsafe teacher identity strings out of teacher AI session issuance, ownership lookup, helper routes, external storage keys, and AI access session claims.
